title: Sphere packing in dimensions 8 and 24
statement: The E8 lattice packing is densest in dimension 8 and the Leech lattice packing in dimension 24.
how_it_was_proved: Viazovska (dimension 8) and Cohn, Kumar, Miller, Radchenko and Viazovska (dimension 24) built, from modular forms, the auxiliary functions of the Cohn-Elkies linear programming bound. The formal proof was begun by Hariharan, Birkbeck, Lee, Ma, Mehta, Poiroux and Viazovska and completed with the autoformalization system of Math, Inc.

sources.cite: H. Cohn, A. Kumar, S. D. Miller, D. Radchenko and M. Viazovska, Ann. of Math. 185 (2017) 1017-1033
S. Hariharan et al., Progress in formalizing sphere packing in dimension 8, arXiv:2604.23468

steps.statement: Cohn-Elkies: an auxiliary function with sign conditions bounds the density
The auxiliary functions, built from quasimodular and weakly holomorphic modular forms
Their sign conditions, reduced to finitely many inequalities checked by computation
